title: 出張中のとっさのひと言

items.en: Hey, Nina, our gate changed. We need to cross the terminal.
items.jp: ねえニナ、搭乗口が変わったよ。ターミナルを横切らないと。
items.speak: Hey, Nina, our gate changed. We need to cross the terminal.

items.en: The flight's delayed, so we have time to grab something to eat.
items.jp: 便が遅れてるから、何か食べる時間はあるね。
items.speak: The flight's delayed, so we have time to grab something to eat.

items.en: Excuse me, is this the line for bag drop?
items.jp: すみません、ここは手荷物預けの列ですか？
items.speak: Excuse me, is this the line for bag drop?

items.en: Hey, folks, did they change the boarding time again?
items.jp: みなさん、搭乗時刻また変わりましたか？
items.speak: Hey, folks, did they change the boarding time again?

items.en: I dunno. The screen still shows the old time.
items.jp: 分からないな。表示板はまだ前の時刻のままだよ。
items.speak: I dunno. The screen still shows the old time.
items.note: 元の形: do not know／聞こえ方: ダノウ／使う場面:分からない時

items.en: Maya, can you keep an eye on my bag while I get water?
items.jp: マヤ、水を買ってくる間、荷物を見ていてくれる？
items.speak: Maya, can you keep an eye on my bag while I get water?

items.en: I left my charger in the hotel room. Do you have a spare?
items.jp: ホテルの部屋に充電器を忘れた。予備を持ってる？
items.speak: I left my charger in the hotel room. Do you have a spare?

items.en: Hey, Alex, the client moved the meeting up to nine.
items.jp: ねえアレックス、顧客が会議を9時に前倒ししたよ。
items.speak: Hey, Alex, the client moved the meeting up to nine.

items.en: I gotta check whether the hotel has a shuttle.
items.jp: ホテルに送迎バスがあるか確認しなきゃ。
items.speak: I gotta check whether the hotel has a shuttle.
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: ガラ／使う場面:必要を伝える

items.en: Sir, could you tell me where the airline desk is?
items.jp: すみません、航空会社のカウンターはどこか教えていただけますか？
items.speak: Sir, could you tell me where the airline desk is?

items.en: The overhead bin's full. Can I check this at the gate?
items.jp: 頭上の棚がいっぱいです。これを搭乗口で預けられますか？
items.speak: The overhead bin's full. Can I check this at the gate?

items.en: Hey, Jen, grab the folder. I'll take the coffee.
items.jp: ねえジェン、書類を持って。コーヒーは私が持つよ。
items.speak: Hey, Jen, grab the folder. I'll take the coffee.

items.en: The app says our connection leaves from C six now.
items.jp: アプリだと、乗り継ぎ便は今C6から出るって。
items.speak: The app says our connection leaves from C six now.

items.en: Didja see if the train to downtown is still running?
items.jp: 中心街行きの電車がまだ動いてるか見た？
items.speak: Didja see if the train to downtown is still running?
items.note: 元の形: did you／聞こえ方: ディジャ／使う場面:くだけた確認

items.en: Beats me. The service notice is only in the local language.
items.jp: さあね。運行案内が現地語だけなんだ。
items.speak: Beats me. The service notice is only in the local language.

items.en: Hey, boss, the client samples are in my checked bag.
items.jp: すみません、顧客用のサンプルは預け荷物に入っています。
items.speak: Hey, boss, the client samples are in my checked bag.

items.en: Can you print the agenda at the hotel before breakfast?
items.jp: 朝食前にホテルで議題を印刷してもらえる？
items.speak: Can you print the agenda at the hotel before breakfast?

items.en: I was gonna email it, but the airport Wi-Fi keeps dropping.
items.jp: メールで送るつもりだったけど、空港のWi-Fiが何度も切れる。
items.speak: I was gonna email it, but the airport Wi-Fi keeps dropping.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ワズガナ／使う場面:予定を説明する

items.en: Wait, what? They moved us to a different hotel?
items.jp: え、何だって？別のホテルに変更されたの？
items.speak: Wait, what? They moved us to a different hotel?

items.en: Hey, Mia, can you ask if breakfast is included?
items.jp: ねえミア、朝食付きかどうか聞いてくれる？
items.speak: Hey, Mia, can you ask if breakfast is included?

items.en: The front desk needs our company name for the invoice.
items.jp: 請求書に会社名が必要だとフロントが言ってる。
items.speak: The front desk needs our company name for the invoice.

items.en: Gimme a second. I saved the booking email somewhere.
items.jp: ちょっと待って。予約メールをどこかに保存したはず。
items.speak: Gimme a second. I saved the booking email somewhere.
items.note: 元の形: give me／聞こえ方: ギミ／使う場面:少し待ってもらう

items.en: Could we get a quiet room away from the elevator?
items.jp: エレベーターから離れた静かな部屋にしてもらえますか？
items.speak: Could we get a quiet room away from the elevator?

items.en: Hey, Chris, the receipt's in the side pocket of my bag.
items.jp: ねえクリス、レシートはバッグの横ポケットに入ってるよ。
items.speak: Hey, Chris, the receipt's in the side pocket of my bag.

items.en: We need to leave early if we're taking the airport train.
items.jp: 空港電車に乗るなら、早めに出ないと。
items.speak: We need to leave early if we're taking the airport train.

items.en: The taxi's here. Lemme tell the desk we're checking out.
items.jp: タクシーが来たよ。フロントにチェックアウトすると伝えさせて。
items.speak: The taxi's here. Lemme tell the desk we're checking out.
items.note: 元の形: let me／聞こえ方: レミ／使う場面:手続きに行く時

items.en: Nora, your passport's still on the counter.
items.jp: ノラ、パスポートがまだカウンターに置いてあるよ。
items.speak: Nora, your passport's still on the counter.

items.en: Oh, wow. Thanks for catching that before we left.
items.jp: わあ、出発前に気づいてくれてありがとう。
items.speak: Oh, wow. Thanks for catching that before we left.

items.en: I don't know. The airline hasn't posted a new departure time.
items.jp: 分からないな。航空会社は新しい出発時刻をまだ出してない。
items.speak: I don't know. The airline hasn't posted a new departure time.

items.en: No idea. Let's ask the gate agent.
items.jp: さあね。搭乗口の係員に聞こう。
items.speak: No idea. Let's ask the gate agent.

items.en: Your guess is as good as mine. The board keeps changing.
items.jp: 私にも見当がつかないよ。表示板が何度も変わるんだ。
items.speak: Your guess is as good as mine. The board keeps changing.

items.en: I couldn't tell you. I just got off the plane.
items.jp: 何とも言えないな。今飛行機を降りたばかりだから。
items.speak: I couldn't tell you. I just got off the plane.

items.en: Hey, babe, I landed. I'll call after I get my bag.
items.jp: ねえ、着いたよ。荷物を受け取ったら電話するね。
items.speak: Hey, babe, I landed. I'll call after I get my bag.

items.en: The room's not ready yet, but they can hold our bags.
items.jp: 部屋はまだ準備できてないけど、荷物は預かってもらえる。
items.speak: The room's not ready yet, but they can hold our bags.

items.en: I wanna grab a coffee before we head to the client site.
items.jp: 顧客先へ向かう前にコーヒーを買いたいな。
items.speak: I wanna grab a coffee before we head to the client site.
items.note: 元の形: want to／聞こえ方: ワナ／使う場面:気軽な希望

items.en: Hey, team, the meeting room's on the fifth floor.
items.jp: みんな、会議室は5階だよ。
items.speak: Hey, team, the meeting room's on the fifth floor.

items.en: I gotta send the revised slides before we take off.
items.jp: 離陸する前に修正版のスライドを送らなきゃ。
items.speak: I gotta send the revised slides before we take off.
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: ガラ／使う場面:締切前の用事

items.en: Could you keep the aisle seat? I may need to get up.
items.jp: 通路側の席にしてもらえますか？席を立つかもしれないので。
items.speak: Could you keep the aisle seat? I may need to get up.

items.en: They lost my bag, and the samples for the demo are inside.
items.jp: 荷物がなくなって、デモ用のサンプルも中に入ってるんです。
items.speak: They lost my bag, and the samples for the demo are inside.

items.en: Sir, could you confirm whether this fare includes one checked bag?
items.jp: すみません、この運賃に預け荷物1個が含まれているか確認していただけますか？
items.speak: Sir, could you confirm whether this fare includes one checked bag?

items.en: The train's delayed. We might be a few minutes late.
items.jp: 電車が遅れてる。数分遅れるかもしれない。
items.speak: The train's delayed. We might be a few minutes late.

items.en: Hey, Dan, didja get the updated itinerary?
items.jp: ねえダン、更新された旅程を受け取った？
items.speak: Hey, Dan, didja get the updated itinerary?
items.note: 元の形: did you／聞こえ方: ディジャ／使う場面:同僚への確認

items.en: I got it, but the hotel address is missing.
items.jp: 受け取ったけど、ホテルの住所が載ってない。
items.speak: I got it, but the hotel address is missing.

items.en: Can you forward me the confirmation? I can't find mine.
items.jp: 確認メールを転送してくれる？自分のが見つからない。
items.speak: Can you forward me the confirmation? I can't find mine.

items.en: The hotel shuttle leaves in ten. Let's head downstairs.
items.jp: ホテルの送迎バスは10分後に出るよ。下に行こう。
items.speak: The hotel shuttle leaves in ten. Let's head downstairs.

items.en: Hey, folks, is this the shuttle for Terminal Two?
items.jp: すみません、これは第2ターミナル行きのバスですか？
items.speak: Hey, folks, is this the shuttle for Terminal Two?

items.en: I left my laptop charger at the hotel. Can I borrow yours?
items.jp: ノートパソコンの充電器をホテルに忘れた。借りてもいい？
items.speak: I left my laptop charger at the hotel. Can I borrow yours?

items.en: We should've booked the earlier flight, but the fare was double.
items.jp: もっと早い便を予約すればよかったけど、運賃が倍だったんだ。
items.speak: We should've booked the earlier flight, but the fare was double.

items.en: Long story short, the room was under the travel agency's name.
items.jp: 要するに、部屋は旅行代理店の名義で予約されてた。
items.speak: Long story short, the room was under the travel agency's name.

items.en: Okay, one thing at a time. First, let's get through security.
items.jp: よし、一つずつ。まず保安検査を通ろう。
items.speak: Okay, one thing at a time. First, let's get through security.
